dialogs.about: 할아버지와 은퇴 뒤의 나이와 지혜를 이야기

lines.en: Do you feel old at our age?
No. I feel young in my heart.
I retired from my work five years ago.
lines.ko: 나는 다섯 해 전에 일을 그만두었어요.

lines.en: Were you happy on that first day?
Yes, I felt free that day.
Our grandchildren are teenagers now.
Time goes by fast. Each generation grows quickly.
lines.ko: 시간이 참 빨리 가요. 세대마다 금방 자라요.

lines.en: What is the best lesson of your life?
Be kind, and thank people every day.
Thank you. I will keep that wisdom always.
Excuse me. Is this class for seniors?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 이 교실은 어르신을 위한 건가요?

lines.en: Yes. Every older adult can come here.
lines.ko: 네. 나이 드신 어른은 누구나 오실 수 있어요.

lines.en: Who comes to the class for young people?
lines.ko: 젊은 사람들을 위한 교실에는 누가 와요?

lines.en: Teenagers come here after school.
lines.ko: 십 대는 학교가 끝나고 여기 와요.

lines.en: Good. Two generations study in one building.
lines.ko: 좋네요. 두 세대가 한 건물에서 공부해요.

lines.en: We opened this class last spring.
I retired from my shop last year.
Many seniors here share their wisdom.
lines.ko: 여기 어르신들이 지혜를 많이 나눠 주세요.

lines.en: Will you have an English class next month?
Yes, it will start soon. Thank you for coming.
lines.ko: 네, 곧 시작해요. 와 주셔서 고마워요.
